challenge.challenge_name: PRISM-AI Challenge: Mammography-based Breast Cancer Risk Prediction

eligibility_review.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review
eligibility_review.rationale: A bounded organized evaluation with registration closure, algorithm-submission deadline and common analysis plan qualifies even without a model-development phase. No official annual edition is specified; 2025 registration opening determines the analytical year, separately from 2026 assessment.
eligibility_review.evidence: Registration opened in December 2025 and closed in June 2026; debugging submissions opened on 4 August. The final test was postponed to 2 November, after the cutoff, so final execution and results are not counted. Existing algorithms predict five-year risk from mammograms, with discrimination, calibration and clinical-utility assessments.
eligibility_review.limitation: No prescribed training dataset. Example inputs are for format checking, not a supplied training cohort. The hidden evaluation cohort covers twenty Dutch screening units; source-cohort and primary-analysis quantities retain separate scopes. Participation rules alone do not establish a data-use licence.

assessment_evidence.scope: Timetables and open phases do not establish assessment execution.

provenance.review_method: Source-linked supplementary documentary review; prior-period start dates checked retrospectively.
